purpose.zh: 练屁股，一条腿把胯顶起来
purpose.en: Builds your butt by lifting your hips on one leg.

text.zh: 一条腿伸直抬起，用屁股把胯顶高
text.en: One leg up straight, drive your hips up with your butt

text.zh: 踩地那只脚踩稳，两边胯骨一样高。
text.en: Plant the working foot and keep both hip bones level.

text.zh: 慢慢放下来，别用腰往上拱。
text.en: Lower slowly. Don't arch your lower back to get up.

commonErrors.en: Hips tipping to one side as you lift.

commonErrors.zh: 撑地那只脚没踩实，靠拱腰把胯顶上去
commonErrors.en: Heel not planted, so your back arches to lift you.

cautions.zh: 腰发紧就顶低一点，屁股用上了就够
cautions.en: If your back tightens, lift a bit lower. Feeling it in your butt is enough.

cautions.zh: 头和肩膀放在垫子上，别用脖子撑
cautions.en: Keep your head and shoulders on the mat. Don't push through your neck.
